name: Chapel Lane and the Elton Hall parkland

layers.essential_history: [[c:Chapel Lane is one of Elton's prettiest streets: look at the house names as you go. At its end it becomes a track into the parkland of Elton Hall, the home of the Proby family since 1660.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Elton Hall was begun by Sir Richard Sapcote in the 1400s. It is a private house, opened to visitors on some summer days, with restored Victorian gardens. Please stay on the public track.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A shepherd by the parkland gate says a rider passed in the night, heading for the river with a bundle in front of him. (Long walk only.)]]
